# The Memory Merchant

The woman's eyes... narrowed...

as she gazed...

at the figure...

It was a face...

she thought...

she knew...

but couldn't place...

The Memory Merchant... watched...

her reaction...

with interest...

A memory... of his own flashed...

in his mind...

a memory...

of a woman...

with eyes...

like... the stars...

*the merchant's gaze...

faded*

The woman still flew

but her heart...

was no longer... free...

She was searching...

for something...

or someone...

*the wind... rustled...

her hair...

as she banked...

and turned...

back towards...

the memory merchant...
